traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs perennial (annual outside the flora); FOC vol. 5: annual or perennial.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs, often suffrutescent (woody at the base).

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems erect to decumbent.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves opposite; FNA vol. 4: leaves more or less equal in each pair.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): opposite leaves, the pair members about equal; decussate as in the family.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences ending in stalked involucres of 1-16 flowers, usually cymose; FOC vol. 5: involucrate flowers in terminal, more or less flat-topped cymes, rarely single.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences terminal and axillary.

traits.bract_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 5 persistent bracts, usually connate, ovate, forming a herbaceous to papery involucre (calyx-like, FOC vol. 5).

traits.inflorescence_bracts.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): involucre of 5 bracts, usually connate, rarely distinct; FOC vol. 5: involucre 5-fid.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): involucres subtend 1-16 flowers; 1-3 in sects. Mirabilis and Oxybaphoides (the key), 6-16 in sect. Quamoclidion.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): chasmogamous perianth radially or slightly bilaterally symmetric.

traits.perianth.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): perianth limb 5-lobed, showy (the family's petaloid calyx; no corolla).

traits.perianth_fused.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): perianth campanulate to funnelform, a tube widening to a 5-lobed limb.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): chasmogamous perianth campanulate to funnelform; FOC vol. 5 calls the limb salverform. The vocabulary's corolla_shape is used for the petaloid perianth.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): limb 5-lobed; bracts 5.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 3-6, exserted; FOC vol. 5: 5 or 6.

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens exserted, the styles beyond them.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Nyctaginaceae (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): gynoecium 1-carpellate (family account).

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruit the family's anthocarp, stiffly coriaceous, ribbed or not; read as achene.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits obovoid, ellipsoid or nearly globose; FOC vol. 5: globose or obovoid.
